story.title: Our Story
story.p1: We are Guangzhou Keyi Information Technology Co., Ltd. Our core team has deep roots in IT and software development for over a decade, gathering elite enthusiasts passionate about technology.
story.p2: KMatrix Knowledge Base is our flagship product. More than just a file-based intelligent knowledge base, it's a masterpiece refined over four years and validated by hundreds of enterprises.
story.p3: From general to industry-specific versions, we stick to the principle of 'quick deployment, quick launch', helping enterprises move steadily and efficiently towards digital transformation.

items.title: Craftsmanship
items.desc: Focus on details, a decade of industry expertise, writing technical excellence through code.

items.title: Customer First
items.desc: Demand-driven, providing rapid deployment and launch support to ensure customer success.

items.title: Secure & Reliable
items.desc: Professional security scanning creates a financial-grade stable knowledge management platform.

tech.title: Tech & Service
tech.p1: We believe in Service First. For customers, we provide more than just products; we deliver comprehensive customized solutions and technical support.
tech.p2: Scanned by the CodeSec platform, our code is secure and bug-free. Combined with cutting-edge LLM and RAG technology, we ensure every delivered system is high-performance and extremely secure.
